literal_meaning: প্রাচীন মুদ্রা বা শামুকের খোসা (cowrie shell or old coin)
figurative_meaning_en: cowrie shell, small copper coin, taka (old monetary units denoting low value)
example_sentences_in_english: He is not worth even a kori.
This thing is as worthless as a cowrie.
history: Refers to ancient and medieval currency in Bengal, where cowrie shells (কড়ি) and copper coins (কপর্দক) were used as small denominations in trade and daily transactions before modern taka.
note: কড়া likely a dialectal variant of কড়ি, used idiomatically to express negligible value in traditional Bengali speech.
